headline: Teva to Lay Off 150 Employees at Kfar Saba Plant in R&D Phase-Out
summary: Teva Pharmaceutical Industries told employees at its Kfar Saba site that it will phase out generic drug R&D there, resulting in 150 layoffs by the end of 2027.
why: Teva is a major global pharmaceutical company specializing in generic and specialty medicines headquartered in Israel.

impacts.name: Teva Pharmaceutical Industries Ltd.
impacts.why: Restructuring and workforce reductions lower operational expenses but signal site downsizing.
